method: Add only previously unmatched named species binomials that differ from pinned WCVP by Unicode multiplication marker, with one unambiguous accepted-ID target. Preserve exact matches and original target-ID policy, including explicit Artificial Hybrid IDs and species synonyms resolving to forms. No fuzzy matching, parent-form substitution, cultivar parsing or ambiguous-name assignment.

rank_caution.species_grouping_rule: Collapse exact canonical species prefixes within already supported cells only. Do not transfer feeding to unrecorded forms or inherit parent-species ranges.

accepted_species_only_sensitivity.rule: Additionally require canonical target rank Species and status Accepted; this is stricter than the original pipeline, so report separately.

CUB_Papilio_demoleus.note: The previously discussed single-lemon alias alone gives seven; the all-marker sensitivity adds other Citrus IDs, including two forms. Ten must not be presented as ten distinct species. Field collection host remains Citrus sp., not retrospectively identified lemon.

verification.separate_pandas_name_join: 63 rescued names and 452 added insect-host ID links match
verification.independent_SciPy_integer_incidence_reco: All primary and three fixed-panel sensitivity totals match before/after; 87,713 species-region matrix cells at each version checked.
verification.code_and_tests: Full local v03 package and incremental patch. This receipt does not imply those local classifier files were merged into the remote branch.

decision: Global positive expansion is maintained (54.8549 to 55.2444 percent), but several Papilio maps change materially. Keep the old 54.9 percent labeled as the frozen literal-name reconstruction. Do not insert corrected 55.2 percent into a manuscript whose figures and nulls still use old inputs.
limitations: This is taxonomic data reconciliation, not new field evidence, host switching, fitness, demographic persistence or causal range expansion. HOSTS biological-record quality and unrecorded hosts remain unverified. Ecological null tests were not rerun with the revised host identities. The frozen 239-species sample was not reselected.
